title: Watersound "A Winterpast by the Sea" 37 Compass Point Way Unit 425
h1: Watersound "A Winterpast by the Sea" 37 Compass Point Way Unit 425
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf views- Private deeded beach access- Minutes to the nearest beach boardwalk- From March 1st to October 31st, 2025, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout- NO PETS ALLOWEDThis property comes with first-come first-serve parking space only. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Sweeping Gulf views and white-sand beaches await at A Winterpast by the Sea. Sleeping up to 10 guests, with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this penthouse WaterSound condo is the perfect getaway for families and groups. Spend sun-kissed days taking advantage of the Puttering Park, winding boardwalks, community pools, and quick beach access. Restaurants, sweet treats, and shopping are a short walk away at The Big Chill. Whether coming for relaxation or active outdoor fun, guests will love starting and ending each day savoring the stunning view from the balcony.Elegant wainscotting, hardwood floors, and soaring ceilings combine with coastal touches and Gulf views to create a refined beach retreat inside this single-story condo. The gourmet kitchen is a dream for chefs, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and a spacious 4-stool breakfast bar to entertain guests. When meals are ready, there’s room for 8 to gather at the wood dining table. After a day in the sun, sink into the living space’s 2 soft couches and armchairs for movies or an evening catching up with the group. Glass doors lead to a vast balcony boasting unbroken views of the Gulf’s deep blue waters and furnished with an intimate seating area and a 2-person bistro set. At the end of the night, retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed, Smart TV, luxurious private bathroom, balcony access, and water views. The 2 lovely guest bedrooms each have a king bed, Smart TV, and private bathroom. There is also a bunk room with 2 full beds lofted over 1 queen bed—ideal for kids or families. For convenience, a washer and dryer are in the closet by the kitchen.Discover why WaterSound is a favored luxury beach destination at A Winterpast by the Sea. Parking is available for 2 vehicles on a first-come-first-serve basis. For beach access, guests can follow any of the boardwalks to the shore—the nearest is by the Dunesider Pool. Book today for a fantastic Scenic 30A vacation!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds Lofted over Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Watersound Community Highlights:-Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach-(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate)-Kayak Rentals-Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks-Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach-A short walk to The Big ChillPlease Note:*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.*Access to the Watersound Beach Club is not included.*Watersound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

Parking is available for 2 vehicles on a first-come-first-serve basis. For beach access, guests can follow any of the boardwalks to the shore—the nearest is by the Dunesider Pool. Book today for a fantastic Scenic 30A vacation!
